description: Unique Identifier - Patient Surrogate Key to maintain the granularity in the dimension table at the source flag and source market level
usage_notes: Use: Create patient-level diagnosis cohorts and link diagnosis activity to treatment/claims data. Limitation: Source-specific patient ID; may need transformation such as removing the SHA_PTDONC prefix for consistent patient-level joins.

description: Date associated with the diagnosis claim/event.
usage_notes: Use: Identify diagnosis timing, establish first/relevant diagnosis dates, and sequence diagnosis activity relative to treatment. Limitation: Represents the claim/event date and may not reflect the actual clinical onset or confirmation date of disease.

Primary diagnosis code as supplied by the source system. The 'SOURCE_' prefix and the '_1' ordinal indicate it is the raw first-position code rather than a mastered or mapped value, implying further positional code columns exist (_2, _3, ...) that this code does not read - so a diagnosis recorded only in a secondary position would be missed. It holds a mixture of ICD-9 and ICD-10 codes in dotted format ('205.00' alongside 'C92.00')

description: Multi-valued diagnosis code field used by the KOMODO feed, holding several diagnosis codes concatenated in one string with a pipe delimiter. Code to split it (split(custom_field_value_1, '\\|')) and posexplodes it into one row per code plus its ordinal position
Identifies the underlying source/feed of the diagnosis data.
usage_notes: Use: Filter to the required claims source and maintain consistency when combining diagnosis data with treatment claims. Limitation: Diagnosis field structure can differ by source; SHA and KOMODO diagnosis feeds may require different parsing/business rules.

description: Identifies the therapeutic market associated with the diagnosis activity.
usage_notes: Use: Restrict diagnosis activity to Oncology (ONC) for VENCLEXTA PoI analyses. Limitation: Should be used with source and indication/market filters to define the intended population.

description: Claim identifier, used as the finest-grain uniqueness token on the claim
